const newItems = $("High Priority Filter").all(); const esc = (v) => String(v == null ? '' : v).replace(/&/g, '&').replace(/</g, '<').replace(/>/g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/�?39;/g, "'").replace(/ /g, ' ').replace(/&/g, '&').replace(//g, '>').replace(/"/g, '"').replace(/'/g, '''); const hasData = newItems && newItems.length > 1 && newItems[0].json && Object.keys(newItems[0].json).length > 1; if (!hasData) { return [{ json: { has_items: false, item_count: 0, items: [] } }]; } // If no new high priority items, return empty to skip email if (newItems.length === 0) { return []; } const highPriority = newItems.filter(i => i.json.urgency_score > 6); const criticalItems = newItems.filter(i => i.json.impact_level === 'Critical'); const highItems = newItems.filter(i => i.json.impact_level === 'High'); const htmlEmail = `

${newItems.length}

${highItems.length}

Read Full Update →
`).join('')}
` : ''} ${highItems.length > 0 ? `

`).join('')} ${highItems.length > 10 ? `

` : ''}
` : ''}

Generated by Mycroft Financial Intelligence System

`; return [{ json: { html_email: htmlEmail, total_new: newItems.length, critical_count: criticalItems.length, high_count: highItems.length, item_ids: newItems.map(i => i.json.id), // Track which IDs were sent has_items: true } }];

parameters.query:
UPDATE regulatory_feeds
SET 
  email_sent = TRUE,
  email_sent_at = NOW()
WHERE 
  id = ANY($1::int[])
  AND email_sent = FALSE;
